description: 28BYJ-48 on a ULN2003 board: IN1-IN4 = PB12-PB15, half-step sequence every 2 ms, 4096 half steps cw, 500 ms off, 4096 ccw, USART1 progress log
expect:
72 MHz; PB12-PB15 push-pull, written with one BSRR store per half step. USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1: '28BYJ-48 half-step 1 rev each way
'; PB15..PB12 start at 0001 (IN1), then every 2 ms (HAL_GetTick deadlines, no drift) the next half step of 1000, 1100, 0100, 0110, 0010, 0011, 0001, 1001 (IN1..IN4) ascending; 'cw 1024/4096
' after 1024 half steps (2.048 s), 'cw 2048/4096
', 'cw 3072/4096
', 'cw 4096/4096
' (one output revolution); all coils off for 500 ms; then descending with 'ccw 1024/4096
' ... 'ccw 4096/4096
'; off 500 ms; repeat. A 28BYJ-48 on the ULN2003 board (OUT1-4 = ORANGE, YELLOW, PINK, BLUE) turns one revolution clockwise and back.

circuit: PB12-PB15: ULN2003 IN1-IN4 in the full circuit (motor position covered by tests/devices/motors-firmware.test.ts); unconnected on this bench
USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)
